output.reason: The brief uses site comparisons (Millbrook with the app and a coordinator, Quarry Lane with no app and no coordinator) and a sharp 88% vs 11% lapse split to rule out the app on its own, the background check and the competing group, and it gives concrete, cheap next steps, though the site-level and slot-loss data aren't evidence I've seen.
